findings.reason: naming the owner makes §7 feed EfitLabels into build_geometry_from_arrays instead of writing a second reduction, which is the reuse the section's own drift argument requires.
findings.text: §7's SELENE reference loader (docs/plans/jt60sa-machine-map.html:716-718) reduces a SELENE EfitLabels (psi, boundary, axis) into an EquilibriumGeometry while citing only the return type, but that reduction is already owned by build_geometry_from_arrays (imas_ambix/worldmodel/equilibrium_labels.py:477), reached via load_equilibrium_geometry (line 400) which is the default loader behind read_efit_geometry's seam (imas_ambix/eval/efit_referee.py:118); a parallel adapter would re-derive the X-point null-set handling, the LCFS radius resampling at fixed poloidal angles and the frame projection — exactly the axis/COCOS drift the plan says this chain exists to prevent

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the open work extends existing deep modules with narrow additions (one untransformed accessor on VirtualZarrView, two extracted helpers in eddb.py, a machine-keyed pin table and registry) rather than spreading new behaviour across wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §7 reduces a SELENE EfitLabels into an EquilibriumGeometry without naming the existing builder that owns that reduction.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface states in its own text what it retires or merges or why nothing can be (§2 exporter "retires nothing, because ambix has no exporter"; §7 pin table "retires three public definitions ... and adds one"; §6 EQDB types "retire nothing, because no equilibrium-database request type exists").
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan names the mechanism it extends for each open node and the codebase confirms each exists (eddb.write_channel, VirtualZarrView, cocos_convention._observation_from_series, machine_identity.default_registry, spine_bench.shots.FROZEN_SHOTSET, eval.efit_referee.read_efit_geometry).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the EQDB transport and grid writer are additions inside the owning modules (eddb_remote.py, eddb.py) and the plan states why the channel types cannot be widened rather than sitting beside them.
